info.title: filex - files and agents API
info.description:
The routes under `/api/files` (what the web explorer, the desktop app, embeds and `filex client` call) and `/api/ai` (the agent surface: REST and the MCP endpoint). Every operation here is a route the server registers: `web/tests/docs/openapiRoutes.test.ts` holds this file to `backend/internal/api/routes.go` in both directions - no operation the server does not serve, no `/api/files` or `/api/ai` route left out. The admin API (`/api/admin`, `/api/ai/admin`) is not described here; see docs/BACKEND.md.

Paths of files are `<storage>://<path>`. A change sent by a browser with only the session cookie from another origin is refused (`403 cross_origin_refused`); a Bearer or `X-Filex-Token` header is not affected. An API token is held to its verbs (`x-filex-token-verb` on `/api/files`, `x-filex-token-scope` on `/api/ai`).
